name: Wit of the Dispassionate Island
body:
School Necromancy; Level: jester 8

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (190 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: One creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target takes 2d10 points of phrenic damage +1 point per caster level, and the target is stunned until it makes a successful saving throw at the end of each of its turns. Until the end of combat, you take any ongoing damage (including bleed damage) at the end of your turn instead of at the beginning of your turn.
